Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures
Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id AND activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075145' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.tid = 11004
Filter: activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.tid = 11004
Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
Limit: 1000
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
INNER JOIN assays AS ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary AS td ON ass.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary AS md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures AS cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075145'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND td.tid = 11004
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
